targets.performance: Share of completed ratings in ordinal categories4/5 at the next quarter-end wave. No arithmetic mean of ordinal scores, individual rating prediction or employee-wide inference.
targets.promotion: Fraction of the known eligible population at each next monthly cohort opening promoted within90days. All eligible members, including exits and non-promotions, remain denominator; full followup required.
targets.turnover: Existing monthly voluntary-exit counts for the next3calendar months, plus derived quarter-total error. Rate remains unsupported.
targets.hiring: Existing all-opening monthly cohorts' fraction starting within90days for next3calendar months.
targets.satisfaction: Existing next quarterly mean respondent favorable-answer share in score points.

features: New targets base uses released target lags, calendar and historical denominators. Existing domains base reuses original enriched features exactly. Performance/promotion/both add only released historical aggregate fields and availability/missing flags. Every Ridge/RF/GB in a tier uses identical rows, target weights and features. No scenario/seed/target denominators or future events enter predictors.
association: New performance/promotion panels share explicitly hypothetical lagged drivers. Auxiliary panels have independent RNG streams from existing turnover/hiring/survey panels: their addition is a negative-control ablation, not a planted cross-domain benefit or a test of real-world predictive value.
selection: No tuning. All hyperparameters fixed before any intended training or test seeds. Fit once using training seeds and labels available by fitLabelsAsOf, then freeze audits in a commit before generating test histories. No test-selected champion or narrower scenario adoption after overall rejection.
additionalBaselines: Existing native baseline bridge unchanged. Turnover also includes original SES alpha grid[0.2,0.5,0.8], minimum training-only one-step SSE with first-grid tie; same24month history as trees, flat level at each fixed target. Performance/promotion have last, recent and clipped OLS trend; promotion has pooled24cohort fraction.
fitWeights: Historical target denominators for performance/promotion/hiring; equal rows turnover/satisfaction. Zero-exposure rows have zero weight, never become positive labels.
scoring: Per-history-origin MAE/RMSE; fraction targets use target-denominator-weighted percentage points and exact aggregate-binomial Brier/logloss. Also pooled bias/reliability with fixed10probability bins. Target denominators used only in fitting past labels/scoring, not future features. Turnover also reports quarter-total absolute error. Months, scenarios and domains sharing a seed are not independent samples.

adoptionGate.comparison: Each full RF/GB tier must satisfy aggregate, scenario/origin and per-horizon gates against BOTH its matching-feature Ridge and fixed native primary. Turnover must additionally satisfy aggregate and scenario/origin quarter-total gates, including against SES for monthly and quarter-total errors. Probability targets must pass bias/ECE/proper-score gates. Native unsupported cells retained outside accuracy scope; instrument-incomparable targets unscored. Every other low-support scored cell fails. Any failure rejects adoption across the declared scope.

ablationGate: Performance-only, promotion-only and both additions evaluated against the SAME estimator's base arm on identical cases. Useful-for-this-simulation only if meanMAE improves5% and no scenario/origin worsens>10%; otherwise no demonstrated robust value. Not a causal or real-data result. Report all failures and unchanged support.
reserve: No October–December2026 labels evaluated; no person-level decisions, sensitive traits, real source qualification, production model/input-boundary or database changes.
